description: This Python source file defines the TurnTraceObserver class, which integrates with OpenTelemetry to create hierarchical tracing spans for conversation turns in a chat or voice system. It manages conversation and turn spans, handles start/end events, and provides context for tracing across services.

classes.name: TurnTraceObserver
classes.description: A class that creates and manages OpenTelemetry trace spans for each conversation turn, supporting hierarchical tracing with conversation and turn spans, and integrating with turn tracking events.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the TurnTraceObserver with turn tracker, optional conversation ID, and span attributes. Sets up event handlers for turn start/end.

methods.name: on_push_frame
methods.description: Placeholder method for processing a frame; does not modify frames, relies on turn events.

methods.name: start_conversation_tracing
methods.description: Starts a new conversation span, generating or using provided conversation ID, and sets relevant attributes.

methods.name: end_conversation_tracing
methods.description: Ends the current conversation span and any active turn span, clearing context.

methods.name: _handle_turn_started
methods.description: Handles turn start event by creating a new turn span, setting attributes, and updating context.

methods.name: _handle_turn_ended
methods.description: Handles turn end event by ending the current turn span and recording duration and interruption status.

methods.name: get_current_turn_context
methods.description: Returns the span context of the current turn span for use by services.

methods.name: get_turn_context
methods.description: Returns the span context for a specific turn number.
